proposal.architecture_precedent: aarch64 row: ubuntu-24.04-arm / cibw_archs aarch64; Windows ARM64 row: windows-11-arm / ARM64 (#178). Fork guards: none.
proposal.build_backend_and_native_dependencies: setuptools (setup.py Extension from module.c, timezone.c, isocalendar.c); no third-party native libs; python_requires>=3.8; tests need pytz.
proposal.contribution_rules: CONTRIBUTING.md and PR template; no CLA/DCO; add CHANGELOG entry; avoid arch-specific hand-written code.
proposal.existing_riscv64_work: Open issue #181 only; no PRs. Downstream RISE wheels exist for 2.3.3 cp312-cp314.
proposal.rationale: ciso8601 is a pure C extension with no native third-party libraries and no arch-specific code. Latest PyPI release 2.4.1 has no riscv64 wheel. Upstream uses cibuildwheel with a per-arch matrix; the fork closeio/cibuildwheel v4.3.5 supports riscv64, resolving the prerequisite in #181. Maintainers have merged analogous native-runner additions (#178, #151) and now test every wheel in CI (#192). ALT Linux builds 2.4.1 on riscv64. A bounded change adds a ubuntu-24.04-riscv matrix row and riscv64 to linux archs, with CHANGELOG note. Risks: the RISE runner must be enabled on the closeio org (maintainer action); runner label may leave jobs queued upstream; pending PR #176 may conflict in pyproject.toml; cp38/pp riscv64 builds may be empty (CIBW_ALLOW_EMPTY set); manylinux_2_39 riscv64 image defaults must be validated; tests (unittest+pytz) must pass natively.
proposal.release_coverage: PyPI 2.4.1 (2026-11-09): macOS arm64/x86_64/universal2, manylinux1 x86_64 + manylinux2014 aarch64, musllinux x86_64/aarch64, win_amd64 and win_arm64 (cp311+), CPython 3.8-3.15, PyPy 3.8-3.12; no riscv64.
proposal.release_graph: build-wheels.yml (workflow_call/workflow_dispatch/pull_request) -> test -> build_wheels, build_sdist; release.yml dispatch calls it with upload:true; manual PyPI upload.
proposal.target_matrix: ubuntu-24.04-riscv, CIBW_ARCHS riscv64, manylinux_2_39 default image, cp39-cp315 (+cp38 via legacy step if empty tolerated) and PyPy where manylinux riscv64 images exist; test with python -m unittest.
